chunks: So do not let not the unbelief of disbelievers grieve you. They will be brought back to Us, when We shall tell them what they used to do. Whatever is in their hearts is known to God.

key_terms.بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ: of the contents of the chests/hearts

ai.seo_question: Why should the Prophet not be grieved by the disbelief of others according to Surah Luqman?
ai.summary: In the context of Luqman’s wisdom, this verse serves as a psychological anchor for the Prophet, shifting his focus from the immediate rejection of disbelievers to the certainty of divine recompense. Shia exegetes emphasize that 'informing them of their deeds' implies a detailed accounting of both outward actions and inward intentions, highlighting God's omniscience regarding the hidden states of the heart (dhāt al-ṣudūr).
